## B — AI Analyzer | UNPUBLISHED
Manual entry runs 50 deterministic checks. RUN_LIVE is false in Fictional analyzer test input. If enabled, it invokes this workflow's reusable trigger once with an allowlisted fictional message.

Uses the project's own Gemini credential. Google rejected 2.5 Flash-Lite with a 404; 3.5 Flash-Lite passed live tests on 2026-10-17. No billing was enabled. Optional dates and company names may remain null.

## Dick Capital source policy v3.0
Owner confirmed: standalone allocation-price chat updates mean OPEN; bare sold means CLOSE; explicitly partial sales mean REDUCE. Exact evidence, portfolio, post identity and state transitions are still mandatory. No inference of missing history. Existing Gemini credential/model preserved. Manual preview selectors remain OFF.
